name: subterrans
description: A modern ant colony simulation game — spiritual successor to SimAnt (1991)
author: Rob Ogilvie

scripts.lint: eslint src/ scripts/ tests/ bench/ eslint-rules/ *.ts
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src/ scripts/ tests/ bench/ eslint-rules/ *.ts --fix
scripts.lint:types: eslint --config eslint.typecheck.config.ts src/ scripts/ tests/ bench/ eslint-rules/ *.ts
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:bench && npm run typecheck:tooling && npm run lint:types && bash scripts/check-sim-boundary.sh && bash scripts/check-asset-paths.sh && bash scripts/check-e2e-geometry.sh && bash scripts/check-layout-discipline.sh && npm run check:cycles && npm run test
